t: The No Nonsense 830 Anti-Mould Neutral Sanitary Silicone Sealant in Silver Grey is a solvent-free, neutral cure sealant designed for creating a durable, water-resistant seal. This 310ml cartridge is ideal for professional use in bathrooms and kitchens, sealing around wash basins, bath tubs, and shower trays. It offers excellent resistance to mould, heat up to 120°C, and UV, ensuring longevity. The formulation is non-corrosive towards metal and adheres reliably to ceramics, glass, enamel, stainless steel, and various plastics, providing a robust finish for interior applications.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
